items.text: Young Arthas must learn patience to temper his power. I will pray that he one day learns how to lead with care rather than force.

items.name: Arthas' Gold Coin
items.text: Already, I've a kingdom in my prospects, a land to rule. What to ask for? Perhaps a frozen scone...

items.name: Arugal's Gold Coin
items.text: I wish someday to retire to my own tidy little estate, with a bunch of pet dogs to keep me company.

items.name: Brann Bronzebeard's Gold Coin
items.text: Brann Bronzebeard was here.

items.name: Kel'Thuzad's Gold Coin
items.text: Sometimes... I wish someone would come along and just give me a big, long hug.

items.name: Lady Jaina Proudmoore's Gold Coin
items.text: Arthas, my love, please come back to me.

items.name: Lady Katrana Prestor's Gold Coin
items.text: Listen, little wishing fountain. You'll give me all your power if you know what's good for you.

items.name: Sylvanas Windrunner's Gold Coin
items.text: I hope my sisters and I can grow up and get married together. This coin appears to be very old.

items.name: Tirion Fordring's Gold Coin
items.text: It is my wish that my dear Taelan will grow strong enough to defend the people he cares for.

items.name: Archimonde's Gold Coin
items.text: I wish to know how you survived my wrath, little fountain.

items.name: Valdrus Blackthorne's Gold Coin
items.text: Explain my dreams, little fountain. Why must I always be viewing my kin from above and moving them like pawns?

items.name: Umbrinoth's Gold Coin
items.text: It seems my moonlighting days as a postal worker are coming to an end.

items.name: Thrall's Gold Coin
items.text: Grom, may you rest well, old friend.

items.name: Sonya Darkhallow's Gold Coin
items.text: This doesn't make sense. Why am I putting a coin in a fountain?

items.name: Zarla Ober's Gold Coin
items.text: The amount of coins shining in the pool. Maybe no one will notice if I take just one.

items.name: A Footman's Copper Coin
items.text: Wish I had that cousin of mine's duty to do nothing more than lug wood around carelessly...

items.name: Vargoth's Copper Coin
items.text: I wish Captain Sanders would hurry up with my shipment of wine.

items.name: Ansirem's Copper Coin
items.text: I wish for happiness and acceptance for my daughter. She feels so out of place here...

items.name: Attumen's Copper Coin
items.text: Can I have a more comfortable saddle? My hindquarters ache.

items.name: Danath's Copper Coin
items.text: I hope a troll dies, right... NOW.

items.name: Elling Trias' Copper Coin
items.text: Being a rogue is hard work. Someday I hope to pursue my life's one true passion...

items.name: Falstad Wildhammer's Copper Coin
items.text: I hope I end up in another book eventually.

items.name: Inigo's Copper Coin
items.text: I wish I had my father back...

items.name: Landro Longshot's Copper Coin
items.text: I wish I'd kept that coin...

items.name: Squire Rowan's Copper Coin
items.text: I wish people would stop knocking my toys off the shelf.

items.name: Rath'mael's Copper Coin
items.text: I could have used this copper for something productive. Perhaps something with string and a machine.

items.name: Mason's Copper Coin
items.text: It's not even magical here.

items.name: Ofalo's Copper Coin
items.text: How does a tavern run out of ale!

items.name: Sair's Copper Coin
items.text: I miss my sword and shield. I feel so naked without my sword and shield.

items.name: Rhonin's Gold Coin
items.text: Here you go, Nozdormu. What was I supposed to do after this?

items.name: Elaadrin Evengale's Silver Coin
items.text: How do I prove they copied us with this fountain?

items.name: Old Key
items.text: An old key.

items.text: Many gathered. Many watched.
